audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY / diffRating 7.5-10 does not match a 51.26% Renekton win rate over 4413 games, and the mirror (karma__renekton) already settled this lane as even.
audit.why: Emerald+ win rate is 51.26% in Renekton's favour; the mirror audit set Karma's side to 5.5/10 difficulty and reworded the difficulty lines to even.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, carryRating 6.5/10, and the difficulty/rating prose reworded to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers reads Karma / Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Karma / Renekton / Renekton, which contradicts the packet chart and the already-published mirror.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the mirror both give Skill / Renekton / Skill / Karma / Renekton / Karma / Karma. The content whys[] already describe exactly that progression (level-2 Renekton window, level-3 evens out, 4-5 Mantra, level-6 Dominus, first item and 2 items to Karma) — only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill / Renekton / Skill / Karma / Renekton / Karma / Karma, with ratings and the three contradicting full-layer whys reworded.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player Karma can hold Inspire (E) to absorb the empowered W, and tells Renekton to go 'through her E shield's brief recast gap'.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Ruthless Predator (W): above 50 Fury it slashes three times, 'destroying damage shields on the target', deals high damage and stuns for 1.5 seconds. The shield is deleted, not spent absorbing — so there is no gap to wait for. W is also an auto-attack reset. Karma's Mantra-W (Focused Resolve) heals her and extends the root, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0], wants.foe[1] and spikes[0].text now state shield destruction and the 1.5s empowered stun; whys[3] states the Mantra-W self-heal and the anti-heal requirement.

audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s cooldown at every rank — the page's 'track it before every commit' framing is right; the number is now used in phases[3].why.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her Mantra window: Focused Resolve roots and Mantra-Q slow-fields your farm. Step up only on that 12s W cooldown, otherwise take CS safe.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Her AP item doubles Mantra-Q burst — fight only on your Eclipse timing with Focused Resolve down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Karma carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: full-AP Karma kites and nukes from 950 range. Carry threat 6.5/10 — group and let your team eat the poke, don't duel.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Carry threat: 6/10. If Karma gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 6.5/10. If Karma gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Karma carry threat 6.5/10.

edits.before: Land empowered W-stun (50+ Fury) through her E shield's brief recast gap to delete her HP before she can kite
edits.after: Land 50-Fury Ruthless Predator — it destroys Inspire's shield outright and stuns 1.5s, long enough for a full Q-heal swing

edits.before: Hold E shield for the exact moment W-stun lands — the bonus move speed lets her walk backward out of your Q heal range
edits.after: Shield early and kite on Inspire's move speed — held for the empowered W it is simply destroyed, so she wants distance, not absorption

edits.before: E-in, empowered W-stun, Q-heal fires before Karma can E-shield away — her mana is too thin at level 2 to absorb the burst and trade back.
edits.after: E-in, 50-Fury Ruthless Predator, Q-heal: the empowered W destroys Inspire's shield and stuns 1.5s, and her level-2 mana cannot answer it.

edits.before: Mantra-stacked RQ slow-fields your farming spot every wave and the W tether punishes any E-in with a root you cannot escape.
edits.after: Mantra-RQ slow-fields your farming spot and Mantra-W roots longer while healing her — Grievous Wounds is what wins the long trades.
